description: Four rounds of two flagged bivariate-bicycle [[18,4,4]] blocks in lockstep, one a Z memory and one an X memory (90 ions: 36 data, 36 check and 18 flag ancillas; 4 logical qubits), then the data read out, each block in its own basis. Circuit distance 4; decoded with BP-OSD, its belief propagation capped at 30 iterations. Ranked with every Goal 1 code by the logical error rate per round per logical qubit under qccd-noise@2, with Helios-class physics in which every number is cited.
